title: Studio 154 - Riverfront Double King with Sofa bed
description:
Retreat to the serenity of our Riverfront Double King Suite with Sofa bed. Relax in 2 king-sized beds while soaking in the tranquil Cumberland river views through 10ft arched windows. Utilize the sofa bed for added convenience.

The space
Studio 154 Hotel is a boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Nashville. The original building is historic from the mid-1800's that has been transformed into unique and modern accomodations. Studio 154 Hotel is a 100% digital and mobile key check in experience that requires you to download the hotel app to check in and access your room. Guests choose Studio 154 Hotel for the perfect location to all downtown attractions and festivities and one of a kind accomodations. We look forward to hosting you!

Other things to note
Studio 154 Hotel is located in a row of historic brick buildings. Due to its uniqueness, some rooms do not have windows. It is important that you review the photos of each room and ask the hotel if you have questions about the room prior to booking.
